title: EEG Seizure Detector: explainable, uncertainty-aware seizure screening for EEG recordings and EEG images
description: Open-source research prototype for screening pre-recorded EEG (EDF/BDF/CSV/TXT/NPY) and EEG images (PNG/JPG) for seizure activity. Logistic regression with conformal abstention, per-event explanations, image digitisation with optional amplitude calibration, a desktop application with built-in user guide and training evidence, a command-line tool, an experimental multichannel stage and a live-stream demo. Trained models are included. Research prototype - not a medical device.
